prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: c021 (decay<=0.5, ignore_net_degree halved, adam scheme) is the strongest robust parent; combining it with the modest cap mechanism confirmed in c023 (cap 3.92, all cases valid, +0.77) — but c021's own parent patch already carries cap 3.92, so the untested combination is to *relax* the cap modestly (x2 → 7.84) on top of c021's decay/ignore-degree changes, letting the strongest critical nets pull slightly harder while the halved ignore-degree still spreads weight to moderate-fanout nets for TNS.
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.744 robust(mean-std)=+0.208 min_case=+0.200 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.200 dWNS=+18.8% dTNS=+20.7% overflow~162
  bp-ng45: score=+0.299 dWNS=+17.0% dTNS=+38.4% overflow~115
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.245 dWNS=+12.6% dTNS=+32.5% overflow~128
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: relaxing the cap to 7.84 on c021's decay/ignore-degree base is robustly positive (total +0.744, robust +0.208, all valid). All three cases improved, with bp-ng45 strongest (dTNS +38.4%, dWNS +17.0%) and ariane133-ng45 the floor (+0.200). Mechanism: letting top critical nets pull harder while halved ignore-degree still spreads weight to moderate-fanout nets lifts both WNS and TNS, with overflow staying modest (~115–162). Next step: sweep cap between 3.92 and 7.84 (e.g., 5.5, 6.5) to locate the TNS/overflow optimum before committing.
